children: Shares of Forward Industries declined after the company issued an updated offer to acquire SkyAI for $2.13 a share.
The stock was down 9% to $6.33 in Tuesday afternoon trading. The stock is down 4.3% this year.

The Solana treasury company said it sent a letter to SkyAI proposing to convert each SkyAI share into .306 shares of Forward, adding that SkyAI shareholders could also elect to receive cash. The company said its non-binding offer represents a 50% premium based on the two companies' Monday closing prices.

Forward Industries had previously offered to buy the company at a ratio of 0.367 newly-issued Forward Shares for each SkyAI share. That offer expired in June, with Forward noting SkyAI failed to respond to its proposal.

"Our updated offer reflects our conviction in the value this combination can create," Forward's Chief Investment Officer Ryan Navi said. "Forward has a proven playbook and a track record of execution that delivers value. SkyAI's stockholders have waited long enough. We're ready to move quickly - the next step is for the Board to engage."
Forward asked SkyAI to respond by 5 p.m. ET on Sept. 25.

The updated proposal comes after Forward asked SkyAI shareholders to vote against the company's equity incentive plan and withhold votes from its director nominees at a shareholder meeting later this week.

In a statement on Monday, SkyAI defending its Solana digital asset treasury strategy, and said Forward's initial acquisition proposal wasn't in the best interest of shareholders. It said it could create more value by executing its standalone strategy.
